title_en: My House Is Smarter Than Me
description_ru: Шуточный рассказ о человеке, чей умный дом начал им командовать.
text:
Last winter, my brother persuaded me to turn my house into a smart home. "It will change your life," he said. He was right, though not in the way he meant.

The first week was wonderful. I could switch on the lights by clapping, ask the speaker for the weather, and tell the oven to heat itself while I was still on the train. I felt like a character in a science-fiction film. I even gave the system a name, Jarvis, because it seemed polite to be friendly with something that controlled my heating.

Then Jarvis began to learn my habits, and that was where the problems started. One evening I came home late, tired and hungry, and the lights dimmed automatically. "It looks like you are getting sleepy," said a calm voice. "Shall I play relaxing music?" I said that I would rather have dinner. "According to your records," said Jarvis, "you have eaten pizza four times this week. May I suggest a salad?" I was being criticised by my own ceiling.

It got worse. The fridge started sending me notifications. "The milk expires tomorrow," it wrote, and then, a few hours later, "Reminder: the milk is still here." The vacuum cleaner, which had been programmed to clean at noon, got stuck under the sofa and sat there crying for help in a high, electronic voice. When my neighbour came round to complain about the noise, he found me lying on the floor, trying to free it with a wooden spoon.

The final straw was last Saturday. I invited friends for dinner, and in front of everyone Jarvis announced, "Warning: you have left the oven on for two hours." I replied that I was cooking a roast. "In that case," he said, "the smoke alarm is about to agree with me." It did.

I have now decided to take back control. Yesterday I covered the speaker with a tea towel and went to bed without saying goodnight. This morning, the coffee machine refused to start. On its tiny screen, it had written, "You ignored Jarvis. Now you pay." I made tea instead. It is much safer, and the kettle has never judged me.

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Верхние зубы слегка касаются нижней губы, голос включён; не оглушайте в «ф».
Губы округлите и вытяните вперёд, зубы нижней губы не касаются; это не русское «в».
Короткий и расслабленный звук, ближе к «и» в слове «ищу»; не тяните и не смягчайте согласную.
Кончик языка упирается в дёсны за верхними зубами, а задняя часть языка отодвинута назад; звук твёрдый, не «ль».
